message.content:
**Kite**

In dawn’s first blush it takes its flight,  
A ribbon of hope against the sky’s wide white.  
Its tail a whisper, trailing bright,  
A dance of colors, bold and light.

It soars above the meadow green,  
Past rooftops, trees, where children lean.  
The wind becomes its steady stream,  
A silent partner in a dream.

With every gust it twists and turns,  
Like a story that the heavens learn.  
It sings in loops, in spirals, burns—  
A fleeting moment, then it yearns.

When clouds gather, heavy, gray,  
The kite may falter, sway, delay.  
Yet still it holds its daring way,  
A promise kept until the day.

And when the sun begins to set,  
The kite will glide, no fear of fret.  
For in its heart, a secret net—  
A world of wonder, never met.

So let your spirit lift and rise,  
Like kites that touch the open skies.  
Remember, even in disguise,  
There’s freedom waiting in the highs.
